description: Authored dev mods that are git-tracked here (so a clean build cannot erase them). Each entry's source lives at dev-mods/<path>/. 'dev': true copies it into <install>/mods on every build (devtools/build-headless.ps1; override with -DevMods all|none|<comma-list>). 'release': true makes it a bundled sample: tools/stage_bundled_samples.py packs its mod.json and top-level typed archives into <install>/mods/bundled/<id>.pdmod and lists it in <install>/bundled-mods.sha256, and a fresh profile starts with it enabled (port/include/modmgr_bundled_samples.h).

mods.summary: Halo-Needler-style custom weapon: tracking primary needles, non-tracking explosive secondary with small pink contact explosions.

Maian Crystal Pistol: textured held model, six crystals that are its magazine (fired one at a time, regrow in their sockets), sticky crystal projectile. Rebuilt from its source vault by build_pdweapon.py.
Maian Hover: the two-seat hover vehicle, exactly what the game's mod author builds from dev-mods/maian_hover_vehicle/recipe.json (pd-tests "[maian-vehicle]" fails if the two differ).

Blank Room: a small original level (one room, four pillars, eight player starts) that holds nothing of the original game. The template Forge starts a shareable level from. Built by dev-mods/blank_room/build_blank_room.py.

Model Room: an original level made from a model (model_room.glb, written by dev-mods/model_room/make_model_room.py) by tools/build_level_from_model.py: two platforms on ramps, pillars, cover, eight starts. Forge step F5's example.

Grid Test Rooms: an original arena with two rooms joined by one portal and a navigation loop. Its .pdarena is also the Grid's room template (grid/templates/, CMake PD_GRID_ROOM_SEED; kTemplateSha256 in port/src/forge_room_builder.cpp pins its bytes).
